title: Reconfigure an installed package
summary: Use dpkg-reconfigure to change the settings of a package that is already installed on your system. This often opens a configuration screen where you can adjust options like keyboard layout or timezone.
prerequisites: The package you want to configure must already be installed.

steps.explain: Run dpkg-reconfigure followed by the name of the package you want to adjust. This will launch the package's configuration interface.

placeholders.name: PACKAGE_NAME
placeholders.description: The name of the installed package to reconfigure.

rollback.explain: There is no direct command to undo a reconfiguration. You may need to manually revert changes in the configuration files or reinstall the package.

warnings: Changing package configuration can affect system behavior. Ensure you understand the options before saving changes.
